wholePhysicalScope: Measured 23.8 by 21.4 metre historic hall is placed at the published field coordinate remembered for the older precinct, consistent with mapped parcel and modern compound footprint. Exact historic wall positions are estimated.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the old hall, twin domes, open arcade and square minaret. Closer levels refine the shallow plaster arches and crenellations.
limitations: The historic walls are reconstructed from the measured hall size. Their position within the Overture compound and vertical heights, roof detail, render tint and exact opening locations are approximate.
The model covers the surviving historic hall, minaret, exterior tomb dome and short court. The much larger modern complex and surrounding buildings are separate structures.
